entities.name: Mercadia
entities.description: A mercantile plane where the Weatherlight crash-lands.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: A ship that crash-lands in Mercadia, is stolen by the Cho-Arrim and later repaired by its crew.

entities.name: Mercadia City
entities.description: The Mercadian city whose soldiers arrest the crew and where the magistrate rules.

entities.name: Saprazzo
entities.description: A rival trade city inhabited by enlightened merfolk who switch between fish-tails and human legs.

entities.name: Gerrard
entities.description: Leader of the Weatherlight crew, offered a deal by the Mercadian magistrate.

entities.name: Orim
entities.description: A Weatherlight crew member captured with the ship who grows sympathetic to the Cho-Arrim and attracted to their leader.

entities.name: Takara
entities.description: A crew member who brokers a deal with the magistrate and later engineers the crew's escape.

entities.name: Sisay
entities.description: A crew member who travels to Saprazzo to secure an artifact.

entities.name: Hanna
entities.description: A crew member who travels to Saprazzo to secure an artifact.

entities.name: Cho-Manno
entities.description: Leader of the Cho-Arrim, who took the Weatherlight's arrival as a prophetic sign.

entities.name: Ramos
entities.description: A sky god whose return the Cho-Arrim believe the Weatherlight prophesies.

entities.name: Cho-Arrim
entities.description: A spiritual people who suffer greatly under the greedy Mercadians and steal the Weatherlight.

entities.name: Mercadians
entities.description: Evasive, aloof rulers of the city; nobles are hedonistic and commoners are selfish.

entities.name: Caterans
entities.description: A guild of professional assassins, thieves and horrors who roam the marketplace and slaughter the Cho-Arrim.

entities.name: Thran
entities.description: Ancient builders whose site ruins Gerrard's band discovers.

events.summary: The Weatherlight crash-lands in Mercadia and the crew becomes entangled in local power struggles.
events.quote: the Weatherlight crash-lands in Mercadia, a strange and unfamiliar plane

events.summary: The Cho-Arrim attack and steal the ship, and Mercadia City soldiers arrive to arrest the crew.
events.quote: The ship is attacked by the Cho-Arrim

events.summary: Orim learns that Cho-Manno took the Weatherlight's arrival as a sign of Ramos's return, and grows sympathetic to the Cho-Arrim.
events.quote: Orim slowly becomes sympathetic to the Cho-Arrim's situation and is attracted to their leader.

events.summary: The Mercadian magistrate offers Gerrard soldiers and Cateran mercenaries to recover the Weatherlight in exchange for the ship's return and safe passage.
events.quote: The Mercadian magistrate unexpectedly offers Gerrard an unusual deal.

events.summary: In the ensuing battle the Caterans slaughter the Cho-Arrim indiscriminately.
events.quote: the violent Caterans slaughter the Cho-Arrim indiscriminately

events.summary: Takara brokers a new deal: the crew will repair the Weatherlight for the magistrate in exchange for freedom; Sisay, Hanna and Orim head to Saprazzo for a needed artifact.
events.quote: Takara brokers a new deal with the magistrate

events.summary: Takara engineers the crew's escape; Gerrard's band finds Thran ruins, meets dryads and fights a mechanical war engine.
events.quote: Eventually, Takara engineers the crew's escape.

relations.note: the Cho-Arrim suffer greatly under the greedy Mercadians
relations.quote: The Cho-Arrim are spiritual people who suffer greatly under the greedy Mercadians.

relations.note: mercenaries placed under Gerrard's command by the magistrate
relations.quote: A platoon of soldiers and Cateran mercenaries will be placed under his command
Gerrard's band discovers the ruins of an ancient Thran site
